content.name: Jordan Whitfield
content.title: Junior Software Engineer
content.summary: Junior software engineer a year into a full-time role building scheduling features in TypeScript and Go for a network of 40 outpatient clinics. Shipped a waitlist service that refilled 1,100 canceled appointments in its first quarter. Comfortable owning a ticket from design doc to production alert.

experience.title: Software Engineering Intern
bullets: Built a Go microservice that parsed carrier EDI 214 status messages, replacing a nightly batch job and cutting shipment-status lag from 6 hours to under 4 minutes.
Added table-driven unit tests to a legacy rate-quote package, lifting coverage from 31% to 74% before the team refactored it.
Presented a 12-week internship demo to 60 engineers and product staff; the dispatch team adopted the status feed the following sprint.

experience.title: Junior Software Engineer
bullets: Designed and shipped a waitlist service in Go and PostgreSQL that offers freed-up slots by SMS, refilling 1,100 canceled appointments across 40 clinics in its first quarter.
Rewrote the provider calendar view in React and TypeScript, trimming median load time on large schedules from 3.2 s to 0.9 s.
Joined the on-call rotation after four months and resolved 14 production incidents, writing two runbooks that later shortened similar pages by about 20 minutes each.
Paired weekly with a senior engineer on code reviews, then reviewed 90+ pull requests myself for the four-person scheduling squad.

education.school: The University of Texas at Austin
education.details: GPA 3.6/4.0. Coursework: Operating Systems, Distributed Computing, Algorithms, Databases.

achievements.title: 2nd place, campus 36-hour hackathon
achievements.detail: Built a bus-arrival predictor from city open data with three teammates; 140 teams entered.

achievements.title: Teaching assistant, Data Structures
achievements.detail: Led two weekly lab sections of 30 students for two semesters and wrote autograder tests for four assignments.
